_about: Spoken when the player selects this opponent on the path map. Keys = exact 'enemy' names from opponents.json. See STORY.md for the motives.
Dog: [growls, then wags its tail uncertainly] This floor is its home now - and you smell like a stranger.
Bear: [rises on its hind legs] The den is warm, the Spire is cold. It will not give up its cave to a passer-by.
Bird: [screeches and circles] Nests line every ledge of this shard. Anything that climbs is a threat to the eggs.
Goblin: Shiny shard? Mine now! Finders keepers - the tower said so!
Skeleton: [rattling bones] The Spire forgot these dead long ago. They still guard the stairs out of habit.
Elf: Our forest was torn from its world, but it is still our forest. Walk around it, climber.
Vampire: The Spire feeds me, and I feed on climbers. A fair arrangement - for one of us.
Adept Blue Wizard: I have read about climbers like you. Every one of them made things worse. Turn back.
Goblin Artificer: Your shard would make a lovely power core. Hold still while I take it apart.
Merfolk: The tide in this grotto answers to the Spire. So do we - it promised to send our reef home.
Chandra's Pyromancer: My mistress burned her way up these stairs. Nobody else gets to follow her!
Guardian Angel: I take no joy in this. Every shard you carry out loosens the seal above. I cannot let you pass.
Zombie Lord: Climb, fall, come back... the Spire forgets you. I don't. My army needs commanders.
Werewolf: [howls at a moon that belongs to another world] The beast only knows that you are prey.
Griffin: [spreads its wings over the cliff path] Proud and territorial - it has held this ledge for centuries.
Ancient Vampire: I have watched a thousand climbers. The Spire promised me freedom for each one who fails. You will be my last.
High Elf: Our elders sealed something terrible above. Taking your shard back would break their oath. We will not allow it.
Pyromancer: The Heart Shard burns brighter than any fire. When I hold it, I will never need to bow again.
Master Blue Wizard: I have calculated your chances. They are poor - and your success would doom us all. I will save you the trouble.
Esper Artificer: Perfection needs a power source. Your shard will run my workshop for a thousand years.
Merfolk Lord: The Spire swore our reef will flow home when the last climber falls. Forgive me - you are in the way.
Master Green Wizard: Nature mends what is broken. The Spire is wounded - and you are one more wound.
Illusionist: Is this the stair you climbed? Is that your shard? Nothing up here is what it seems... least of all you.
Goblin Chief: Big boss of all the goblins wants the big shiny shard. Big boss gets what big boss wants!
Master White Wizard: Order holds this tower together. You bring chaos with every step. The law forbids your ascent.
Master Black Wizard: Death is no obstacle in the Spire - only a delay. I will take your shard and your soul.
Necromancer: Every fallen climber joins my collection. You would make an exquisite centrepiece.
Volcano Dragon: The Heart Shard is the greatest treasure in any world. Dragons do not share treasure.
Kor Warrior: My people keep the ancient paths. The seal above must hold - even if it means stopping you.
Dinosaur: [stamps and roars] This jungle shard is its whole world. It will defend every leaf.
Dinosaur Elite: [a deafening roar shakes the cliffs] The alpha of the jungle shard. It has never lost a fight.
Master Red Wizard: Power belongs to those bold enough to seize it. Today, that is not you.
Zombie Master: The Spire is a graveyard of worlds. I simply keep it tidy. Lie down, commander.
Adept Red Wizard: My master needs the Heart Shard. I need my master's favour. You understand.
Orthodoxy Angel: Faith holds the seal. Doubt breaks it. Kneel, climber, and let the tower keep its prisoners.
Goblin King: A king needs a crown! That shard would look great on mine. Get 'em, lads!
Spirit: [a cold whisper] I climbed once, too... and the Spire forgot me. Stay. You will forget soon enough.
Ghalta: [an earth-shaking roar] The ruler of the jungle shard. It does not understand portals - only rivals.
Nahiri: I bound these stones myself, to keep what is above from waking. I will not let you pull them apart.
Niv-Mizzet: Fascinating. Your shard resonates with the Heart. I must study it - you are, regrettably, attached to it.
Sorin: The Spire promised me a way home. I have waited longer than your world has existed. Do not test my patience.
Teferi: I have seen where this ends. If you reach the top, the seal breaks. I am sorry - truly - but time must hold.
Lathliss: My brood was stolen with this shard. The Spire swore to return them when the climbing stops. So it stops - here.
Chandra: I made it to the top before you. This place is rotten to the core - and I'm going to burn it down. All of it.
Sliver Queen: [a thousand voices hiss in unison] The hive is the Spire's immune system. To it, you are an infection.
Emrakul: [the Spire itself groans and shudders] This is the thing that has been devouring the Spire. It has noticed you.
